notes.title: The Giveaway talk
notes.content:
I thought I'd send you a little hello. :-) Besides, I really need to talk to you. 

I know that you guys are playing, but I haven't heard much feedback lately. After Kickstarter, I started to suspect that a lot of you are as introverted as we, the developers, are. Now my assumption has strengthened. :-D 
In addition, I believe that Steam doesn't give you enough incentive to leave a review. Not to mention that everyone constantly asks you to "like" this or "share" that. Hey, I've been in your shoes, I know that it can be quite frustrating. 
Alright! So this is what I think will give us, a small team of two, a chance against games with a huge marketing budget  → 

A GIVEAWAY! 

What do you think about a random giveaway between people who have left a review? Let's say that starting next month we could give away an OST for every 5 reviews, and a game for you to gift to your friend for every 10 reviews? Of course, our first giveaway will be among existing comments, so it would be quite a big one. 

Right now I really want to hear what you have to say about this idea.
If you like it, I will write out a more detailed guideline in my next update. 
Give this announcement a "thumbs up", if you like the idea. 
Or, let me know your thoughts in the comments!

Anna
(developer)

notes.title: KAPIA adventure
notes.content:
KAPIA is a 3D story-driven adventure quest unfolding in a funky apocalyptic universe. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38260044/1e2f0089b7389bb6eed532369aed71ec4b141252.png[/img]


The World Union has collapsed, the nations are divided into coalitions "East" and "West," a mysterious intelligent infection is forcing people to live under city lockdown. This is the world that needs saving–the world of KAPIA.

Amidst the chaos, Stefan, a retired pilot and a strong-willed grandfather, takes on the responsibility of ending the conflict. Little does he know his most powerful ally will be his little granddaughter, Reny.
